summary: Frontend-only test of DigestPreference on /matters. All acceptance criteria met: control visible with Daily initially selected (aria-checked=true, hint 'Every morning at 8am Central'). Weekly click → toast 'Expiry digest set to weekly', hint 'Mondays only'; reload persisted Weekly. Off click → toast 'Expiry digest turned off', hint 'No digest emails'. Daily restore → toast 'Expiry digest set to daily', hint 'Every morning at 8am Central'. Regression on /matters passes: heading 'My Family Matters', filter chips (All Active/Awaiting Both Parents/etc.), matter list card, and 'Search My Private Notes' all render. Preference left on Daily as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: DigestPreference.jsx uses api.get('/me/preferences') on mount without indicating loading state beyond disabling buttons; consider a skeleton for a11y clarity.
Fallback on GET error sets value='daily' locally without a toast — silent failure could mask backend issues.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Digest preference feature fully functional. Preference persisted via PUT /api/me/preferences. Left at 'daily'.
